    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    k = int(input[1])
    edges = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    idx = 2
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            edges[i][j] = edges[j][i] = int(input[idx])
            idx += 1

    def find_center(silos):
        for i in range(n):
            if all(edges[i][j] != -1 for j in silos):
                return i
        return -1

    total_danger = 0
    count = 0

    for silos in combinations(range(n), k):
        center = find_center(silos)
        if center != -1:
            danger = sum(edges[center][j] for j in silos)
            total_danger += danger
            count += 1

    print(total_danger // count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
